definitions.short: Ramah , the name of a grandson of Ham, and of a place (perhaps founded by him)
definitions.full: H7484. Ramah or Rama II. רַעְמָא רַעְמָה, (Gi Intr. 124 ff. ) proper name, masculine 'son' of Cush , הָ֯ Gen 10:7 (twice in verse) = אָ֯ 1Chr 1:9 (twice in verse) (Baer, see his note; van d. H. Gi הָ֯ v b ); Ρεγχμα , Ρεγμα ; הָ֯ as trading people Ezek 27:22 , Ραμα , Ραγμα . Identified by many with city Ῥεγ ( α ) μα (Ptol vi. 7, 14 ), Ῥηγμα (Steph. Byz.), in southeast Arabia, on Persian Gulf (so even DHM ZMG xxx (1876), 122 Glas Skizze ii.251, 325 ), but this is in inscription (Glas ib. 252 ); < Sabean רעֿמה near Me`în in southwest Arabia (Hom Südar. Chr. 131 Hal 535, 11 , compare DHM l.c .), perhaps = Ῥαμμανῖται of Strabo xvi. 4. 24, see Di Gen 10:7 .
